title: maya and tex: small stuff all day

msgs.text: hey
hey Maya, what's up?
ok so weird question. why is the sky blue
Sunlight scatters off air molecules, and shorter blue wavelengths scatter the most, so blue reaches your eyes from every direction.
ok that's actually cool. my cat keeps staring at the wall rn
pretty sure she sees a bug
or a ghost idk
anyway. how long does it take to hard boil an egg
About 10 to 12 minutes once the water is boiling, then straight into ice water for a few minutes so they peel easily.
nice. making egg salad for lunch tmrw maybe
or just eating them standing over the sink like a gremlin
that's a valid lunch
ugh my coffee went cold again. the microwave can't be trusted
do u know how many cups of coffee is safe per day? my sister says it's like 4
For most healthy adults, around 400 mg of caffeine a day is the usual guidance, which is roughly 3 to 4 cups of brewed coffee.
so my sister is right which is annoying
she's always right it's exhausting
ok random: who wrote the lord of the rings
J.R.R. Tolkien.
obviously lol. ok fine that was a warm up. my brain's bad at mornings
that reminds me i need to water the plants on the windowsill, the fern is looking sad
ferns are dramatic. they're fine if u mist them and say nice things
i'm kidding. mostly
ok going to shower and then i'll be a functioning adult
okay i'm out. gonna be late for my walk lol
alright back in a bit
what's 17 times 23
nice. i was about to do it on my fingers under the table lol
ok next. my roommate says bananas are berries and strawberries aren't. is she right
Botanically, yes. Bananas are berries, and strawberries aren't, since their seeds sit on the outside.
lol that's so unfair. ok strawberries still taste better
agreed by everyone who has ever eaten a strawberry
my plants got a little drink. fern lives
the fern is back in the game
honestly the fern is doing the most
ok i'm gonna be on the couch with a book now. the one about the lighthouse. i'll be annoying about it later
lol but it's good so far
anyway night-ish. i'll be quiet
ok bye for real
quick one, what's the capital of australia
Canberra.
ha thank god. i always say sydney and then get roasted
that's the same mistake everyone makes lol
ok i'm gonna make a grilled cheese, a real one, with the good bread
the good bread is from the bakery on the corner and it's way too nice for a sandwich
do u know what cheese melts best
Young cheddar, Gruyère or Monterey Jack all melt well. A thin layer of mustard in the middle helps too.
mustard in a grilled cheese is a bold choice. i'm trying it
ok it's actually really good. respect
the sandwich is in the pan so the next 4 mins are sacred
ok it's done and it's perfect. nobody talk to me
thanks!

must: reply in a few words, the way a friend takes thanks
never: send more than one text, or offer a list of what it can do

msgs.text: Anytime, Maya.
ur the best. i'm eating the sandwich over the sink now which is a lifestyle
ok serious question. is it weird that i still watch cartoons at 11pm
asking for a friend. the friend is me
Not weird at all. Lots of people unwind with cartoons before bed.
ok good. that's what i told myself
honestly the sink is my favorite room in the apartment
the dishes are judging me though
they can wait. they're always waiting
i'm gonna nap for like 20 min then deal with life
ok nap time. i'm off to my couch cave
yo

anyway the apartment is very quiet
i think the radiator is singing
okay brb, dishes
how many days in a leap year again
366 days. The extra one is February 29.
right, the extra day. i always forget which month
lol february yes i checked
february is the shortest month and it still gets an extra day. unfair
the calendar has no chill
ok what's a good podcast for a long walk. not news, i need a break from news
Try a narrative show, like a long-running fiction or history series. Tell me what you usually like and I'll narrow it down.
ok i like true crime but not gory. and i like people being nice to each other
the lighthouse book is my pick right now. the keeper has a bad feeling about the fog
anyway i'm gonna crack the window. the apartment smells like toast

Your dentist appointment is Tuesday, October 13 at 3 pm.
oh right. ok good, i'd have missed it
ok i'm gonna put it in my calendar. this time for real
i have a habit of thinking i'll remember things
anyway my brain is mush today

i'm gonna make the tomato soup from the old recipe card. full circle
the recipe is a little stained which means it's good
going to the store for tomatoes and maybe bread
